# Team99

> Team99 is a 3-member student developer team from Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology & Sciences (GGITS), Jabalpur, studying IoT & Cyber Security (incl. Blockchain Technology). We build fast websites, apps, and AI-hardware projects.

Team99 consists of Akshat Singh Baghel (Founder & Full Stack Developer), Mohammad Naved, and Aryan Vishwakarma. Notable work includes the Smart AI-Based Attendance System.
